parameters.name: grid_position

parameters.description: Narrow to entries that ended a given way, such as Finished or Retired. The statuses marked stable are the five the API guarantees will keep their id. Leave it empty for every status.
parameters.name: status_id

parameters.description: How many rows to return, from 1 to 100, which is the most the API serves in one request. The answer always says how many rows there were in total, so a limited list never reads as a complete one. Defaults to 30.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many rows to skip before returning results, for reading a long list a page at a time. Defaults to 0.
parameters.name: offset

filters.description: The filters this query actually applied, repeated so an empty answer says what was asked for

total_count.description: Rows the API holds for the query

description: Look up any Formula 1 result since 1950. Read the race calendar with every session time, see what is on next and how long until lights out, pull race, qualifying and sprint classifications, follow a championship round by round, and go lap by lap or stop by stop through a single Grand Prix. Jolpica-F1 is the open successor to the Ergast API, and no account or API key is required.
